title: Pricing and cost-value comments
summary: This topic combines comments about whether pricing feels reasonable with complaints that repair or vehicle cost made problems feel unacceptable.

negative.summary: Negative reviews say that a damaged rim led to an out-of-pocket replacement cost and that heat buildup was unacceptable given the vehicle's price.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mention pricing as reasonable or discuss another vehicle's price without enough context to classify sentiment toward the G60.

limitations: The sample is very small, so examples are insufficient to support broader conclusions about pricing perceptions.
This cluster mixes owner cost complaints with general statements about pricing reasonableness and even a comparison to another vehicle, so it is not fully coherent as a single theme.
Several pricing fragments are labeled undetermined, which limits clear interpretation of overall sentiment on value or affordability.
